messages:
Maria (Marketing): quick idea — run a tiny experiment next week targeting new signups: 3 micro-onboarding hooks to see which actually drives first-100-token activation :thinking_face:
Sam (Growth): love it. what are the 3 variants?
Maria (Marketing): Variant A: prompt-templates-first (show curated prompts in-app)
Maria (Marketing): Variant B: timeboxed free credits (48h + countdown CTA)
Maria (Marketing): Variant C: interactive quickstart (mini chat walkthrough) :sparkles:
Eli (PM): define primary metric = % who generate >100 tokens within 7 days? secondary: retention by day 14
Jess (Growth Ops): agree. add cohort: org_size <10 vs >=10. may behave differently.
Arun (Sales Ops): routing question — which variants should surface to sales for follow-up? my gut: timeboxed credits -> sales queue for companies that hit >$200 potential spend in first 2 weeks.
Maria (Marketing): yep. propose routing rules: small orgs -> self-serve nurturing; mid/large -> SDR if they hit threshold.
Sam (Growth): can we instrument these events? first_generate, used_template_id, credit_redeemed, quickstart_completed
Eli (PM): yes. event names: redwood.first_generate, redwood.prompt_template_selected, redwood.credit_redeemed, redwood.onboarding_quickstart_done
Jess (Growth Ops): quick webhook snippet for routing rules (will implement in automation):
Jess (Growth Ops): ```yaml
routing_rules:
  - if: "event.credit_redeemed and company.estimated_14d_spend > 200"
    route: "sales_queue"
  - if: "event.onboarding_quickstart_done and company.size < 10"
    route: "nurture_seq_self_serve"
```
Arun (Sales Ops): perfect. can we also add a flag to tag "high-quality" leads for demos? maybe credit_redeemed + >5 API calls in 48h.
Maria (Marketing): yes — add tag high_quality_lead. Also need the benchmark narrative for the launch post: show expected uplift vs baseline (baseline activation 12% -> target 18-20% with templates).
Sam (Growth): recommended sizes: 3k new signups split evenly across variants for 2 weeks. run Bayesian bandit after 7 days but keep running 14 days for retention signal.
Eli (PM): webinar tie-in idea: invite users who redeemed credits but didn't hit 100 tokens to a 20-min live quickstart at the end of week 2 — that routing is separate but helpful for uplift.
Maria (Marketing): drafting launch post draft this afternoon. callouts: small screenshots of in-app templates, short gif of quickstart, and an explicit CTA to claim 48h credit. keep messaging developer-first and production-ready. :rocket:
Jess (Growth Ops): I'll wire the experiment in Optimizely and create dashboards: activation funnel, 14d retention, cost-per-activated-user. linking console campaign here when created.
campaign-bot: campaign created -> https://console.redwood.ai/campaigns/1773-micro-onboard (campaign id: 1773) :white_check_mark:
Arun (Sales Ops): can we route inbound webhook to Salesforce with a lead_reason param set to variant=A|B|C? makes downstream reporting easier.
Jess (Growth Ops): yep. example payload: `{"variant":"B","first_generate":true,"credit_redeemed":true}`
Sam (Growth): timeline: start split test Mon 9am PT, check early signals Wed, bandit on Thu morning, full analysis after 14 days.
Maria (Marketing): copy review needed @Eli @Sam before send. i'll post draft in #marketing in 2h.
Eli (PM): will review. quick ask — add one prompt template that highlights cost controls and batching tips (so infra-conscious devs see value).
Maria (Marketing): good call. adding 2 templates: "low-latency chat" and "cost-aware summarization".
Jess (Growth Ops): tracking checklist sent to #growth-ops — will ping when webhooks live. :thumbsup:
Sam (Growth): excited — if templates win we should bundle as a "starter pack" in the docs and a /quickstart in the SDK.
Maria (Marketing): agreed. final note: keep language neutral re: pricing in public post; benchmark numbers are for blog/press only.
Arun (Sales Ops): noted. ready to implement routing once campaign is live.
Maria (Marketing): thanks all. next update after campaign-bot confirms live and first 24h report. :eyes:
